title: Interaction to Next Paint
definition: INP measures the latency of all click, tap, and keyboard interactions throughout the lifespan of a page. It indicates how quickly the page responds to user input.
simpleExplanation: When you click 'Add to Cart', does the button immediately show a spinner, or does the entire page freeze for 2 seconds while JavaScript does heavy math?
